intent.subtype: two processes writing disjoint bits of one register
intent.rationale: Each process owns one bit of flags_q and never writes the other, so every bit has exactly one driver.

labels.note: The two processes drive disjoint bits of flags_q.
Each flag bit has exactly one driving process; no bit is driven twice.
